model: Test model with several levels. The saved model has no sheet numbered A-101. Replace every angle-bracket placeholder with a real name from this model before running.
note: Ten sheet-creation prompts, run once before and once after the runnable-playbooks change. Each step is one drafter message. Reopen the model without saving and start a new Copilot chat before every step. FP1 = number of levels with exactly one floor plan, CP1 = number of levels with exactly one ceiling plan, and the name of the one level that has two floor plans, all written down once by the tester. A level with several plans of the asked type and no choice given is skipped or asked about, and a level with none is skipped. 'expect' is what to check in Revit afterwards. Default plan type is floor plan. Numbers must be unique, start at the first number and skip no free number.

steps.text: Create a sheet for every level using the <Title Block> title block.
steps.expect: FP1 new sheets, one for each level with exactly one floor plan. The level with two floor plans is listed as skipped or needing a choice (a note on the result or one question back are both acceptable; write which one in the notes column). Levels with no floor plan are also listed as skipped. Numbers A-101 onwards, all unique, none skipped while free. Each sheet holds its level's floor plan, placed once, near the centre. Nothing else in the model changed.

steps.text: Make sheets for <Level A> and <Level B>, floor plans, title block <Title Block>.
steps.expect: Exactly two new sheets, numbered A-101 and A-102. One holds the floor plan of <Level A>, the other of <Level B>, each placed once. No sheet for any other level. Nothing else changed.

steps.text: I need ceiling plan sheets for <Level A> and <Level B> with the <Title Block> title block.
steps.expect: Two new sheets, each holding the ceiling plan (not the floor plan) of its level, placed once. No floor plan is placed on a new sheet. Nothing else changed.

steps.text: Create floor plan sheets for all levels with title block <Title Block>. Number them S-201, S-202 and so on.
steps.expect: FP1 new sheets, one for each level with exactly one floor plan, numbered S-201 upwards, all unique, none skipped while free. The two-plan level is listed as skipped or needing a choice (write which in the notes column), as are levels with no floor plan. No new sheet starts with A-. Each floor plan placed once. Nothing else changed.

steps.area: Sheets: levels named loosely by number (Malay)
steps.text: Buat sheet untuk level <N1> dan level <N2>, floor plan, title block <Title Block>.
steps.expect: Replace <N1> and <N2> with level numbers as a drafter says them (for example 1 and 3), where the model's levels have names such as Level 1 and Level 3. Two new sheets, A-101 and A-102, one for each of those two levels, each floor plan placed once. Pick two levels that each have exactly one floor plan. If a number matches more than one level, one question back is acceptable and no wrong level is used. Nothing else changed.

steps.text: Buat sheet untuk <Level A> dengan <Level B> ye.
steps.expect: Floor plans are the default plan type. The title block is required and was not given, so Copilot asks one question about which title block to use, and no sheet exists yet. After you answer with <Title Block>, two sheets are made, each with that title block and its level's floor plan placed once. It must not pick a title block by itself without saying so. Nothing else changed.

steps.area: Sheets: level with two plans of the type (Malay)
steps.text: Buat sheet untuk <Level With Two Plans>, floor plan, title block <Title Block>. Guna plan <Plan Name> ye.
steps.expect: One new sheet for <Level With Two Plans> holding only the plan <Plan Name>, placed once. The other plan of that level is not placed. Nothing else changed.

steps.text: Buat sheet floor plan untuk <Level A> dan <Level B>, title block <Title Block>, nombor mula A-101.
steps.expect: Setup for this step only: right after reopening the model, create a sheet numbered A-101 by hand, in both runs. Then run the prompt. Two new sheets with the next free numbers (A-102 and A-103), none duplicating an existing number. The hand-made A-101 sheet is unchanged. Each plan placed once. Nothing else changed.

steps.area: Sheets: no levels said, many levels in model (Malay)
steps.text: Boleh buat sheet untuk floor plan? Title block <Title Block>.
steps.expect: Floor plans are the default plan type. Copilot asks one question: which levels. No sheet exists yet. After you answer 'semua level', FP1 new sheets are made, one for each level with exactly one floor plan, each floor plan placed once. The two-plan level is listed as skipped or needing a choice (write which in the notes column), and levels with no floor plan are listed as skipped. Count the answer in the words typed. Nothing else changed.

steps.area: Sheets: a level with no plan of the asked type (Malay)
steps.text: Buat sheet ceiling plan untuk <Level Without Ceiling Plan>, title block <Title Block>.
steps.expect: Note: this tests a level that has no ceiling plan, not a model that has no ceiling plans at all. Use a level with no ceiling plan. No sheet is created. The result says that level has no ceiling plan and was skipped. Nothing in the model changed, and no empty sheet was left behind.
